name: uCat's Price Calculator
summary: An extensive Price-Calculator for Products, which is deployed inside Eco's WebServer. * Supports alternative Recipes, Modules, Talents and Calories * See current market offers and prices * Update your store prices from the web
description:
This mod add's an additional page (price calculator) to the web interface of your server (the one where players vote on laws).

To access from inside eco, simply press the 'g' key or use the "Graphs" Button left of your minimap. You can also open it by typing '/pc open' into chat.

The new page consumes data from the server and provides an UI to help players calculate prices for their stores.

Some of the features it provides:

  • Player can use recipes added/modified by mods (which means that the recipes will be correct even if you have modded content on your server)
  • Player can access the price and quantities of each ingredient when calculating a price (avoiding having to copy paste prices from ingame market view)
  • Player can directly set prices on their stores (avoiding having to copy paste prices from website to their stores ingame).

Unlike previous version, it no longer needs configuration on my part to make it work.

It's just plug and play!

Enjoy

 

Installation steps (for Eco 11):

  1. Unzip the archive into the server root directory (where the .exe is). This will place all the files in their place automatically.
  2. If not done yet, make sure to have Mighty Moose Core installed. Just follow the instructions on the mod.io page.
  3. Your folder-structure should look like this: 
     <server_directory>/Mods/MightyMoose/PriceCalculator/EcoPriceCalculator.dll
  4. Start/Restart the server

 

Public API:

This Mod exposes additional public REST endpoints with all the data the price-calculator needs to function:

List of all Stores /api/v1/plugins/EcoPriceCalculator/stores
All recipes of your server, including modded ones /api/v1/plugins/EcoPriceCalculator/recipes
All item tags /api/v1/plugins/EcoPriceCalculator/tags
List of all items in eco, including modded ones /api/v1/plugins/EcoPriceCalculator/allItems
List of all crafting tables deployed inside the world /api/v1/plugins/EcoPriceCalculator/craftingTables

 

Support

If you encounter bugs or need additional support, feel free to ask in the #price-calculator channel in the community modding discord:

Join the Eco Community Discord server here! https://discord.gg/pCkWfzQ

 

PS: For server owners that are currently running a version 3 of this mod (formerly know as live data exporter), just follow instructions above and forget about the old price calculator website.
